experiments.decision_gate: A0b serves as the clean-token (cls_patch64) baseline for A1 comparison.
experiments.notes: GFNet cls_patch64 (CLS + 64 patch tokens, no register). Excludes register tokens from FFT sequence. Train-Val Gap narrows slightly vs legacy (0.160 vs 0.168).

experiments.decision_gate: A1 vs A0b: modReLU degraded val_loss (-2.2%), val_pcc (-6.1%), Train-Val Gap widened (+50%). Gate: FAIL → frequency sparsification hypothesis disproven. A2 (frequency augmentation) and A3 (AFNO) cancelled.
experiments.notes: modReLU magnitude threshold truncates weak frequency components, discarding subtle tissue texture info. Some pathways improved (MYC, Wound Healing) but more degraded (Coagulation, Inflammatory Response, E2F, OxPhos). Epoch window delayed (E4 vs E2) but overall worse.

experiments.decision_gate: B1a vs B1b: peak PCC 0.3956 vs 0.3955 — nearly identical. Frequency branch adds no incremental value over mean pooling. Both below CLS Frozen baseline (0.4113). Gate: FAIL → frequency side-branch disproven for CLS mode.
experiments.notes: CLS + GFNet frequency branch on patch tokens. Confounding variable: token_select_mode changed from legacy_firstN to cls_patch64 simultaneously with freq_branch addition. CLS cls_patch64 alone may already degrade vs legacy. Without freq=none + cls_patch64 control, cannot fully isolate freq_branch effect.

experiments.decision_gate: B1b (mean pool) same as B1a (gfnet) → frequency branch has no mechanism advantage. Both < CLS Frozen 0.4113. The CLS+patching side-branch architecture itself may not help.
experiments.notes: Non-frequency control for B1a. Mean pooling on patch tokens as side branch. Result confirms frequency processing is NOT the differentiator — both branches perform similarly below baseline.

MPP-3 train (6 patients, ~42K patches) -> MPP-2/XZY external test. JFX named 'JFX' in MPP root. NaN guard: nan_to_num on raw; clip +-100 only AFTER z-score transform. Codex review fixes applied 2026-07-02: ddof=1, coord matching, metrics key fix, pred order, --no-val guard, HF_HOME, allow_missing.

V3bis: fix V3 overfitting by introducing internal val patient ZHZ. 5 train patients (HYZ,JFX,LMZ,TGC,XSL) -> 1 internal val (ZHZ, val_loss early stopping) -> 1 external test (XZY, single eval after checkpoint selection). Three-layer signal separation. z-score fit on 5 train patients only. val_loss_min selects best checkpoint and triggers early stopping. Min_stop_epoch=max(patience,3).

MPP1 partner training using ljk's pre-extracted features (MPP1_UNI/). 5 train patients (JFX,LMZ12939,TGC,XSL,ZHZ) -> 1 internal val (HYZ15040, val_loss early stopping) -> 1 external test (XZY). XZY cache loaded from MPP1_UNI (only complete copy). ljk's .pt cache stores 265 tokens [265,1536] — auto-detected and CLS extracted. use_partner_paths=True, auto_split=True.

MPP4 partner training using ljk's pre-extracted features (MPP4_UNI/). 5 train patients (JFX,LMZ12939,TGC,XSL,ZHZ) -> 1 internal val (HYZ15040, val_loss early stopping) -> 1 external test (XZY). XZY cache loaded from MPP1_UNI (only complete copy). Fast training (~4s/ep) suggests smaller training set.

MPP2 partner training by wzk. Uses same protocol (5 train + HYZ15040 val + XZY external). Training stopped at ep33 (lr=1.25e-05). Best by val_loss: ep13 (val_loss=0.2360, val_PCC=0.6625). External XZY PCC=0.4555 — significantly below MPP1 (0.71)/MPP3 (0.67). Possible z-score mismatch or cache quality issue.

MPP5 partner training by wzk. 132 epochs with lr decay (1e-4→7.8e-07). Best by val_loss: ep112 (val_loss=0.1300, val_PCC=0.8459, train_PCC=0.98). Despite best val metrics of all 5 MPPs, external XZY PCC only 0.4472 — extreme val↔ext disconnect. Strongly suggests z-score or cache incompatibility with the common XZY test set.

MPP1-5 unified-standard rerun (2026-07-06 plan). Per-patient 10% internal val via spatial block split; train-only z-score rebuilt from raw ssGSEA; MPP-2/XZY fixed external test. Reuses MPP1_UNI partner cache (cross train/val subdir merge by stem). 100% stride MPP, no embargo. Raw-scale MAE/R2 mandatory. 2026-07-09: temporarily abandoned for follow-up despite highest PCC; retain only as PCC-upper-bound background.
